claim: On Mar 14, 2025 the integration of Amazon Data Firehose with Amazon S3 Tables became generally available, a feature that enables customers to deliver real-time streaming data into Amazon S3 Tables without requiring any code development or multi-step processes.
question: Since when can Firehose deliver streaming data into Amazon S3 Tables?

evidence.quote: Today, we are excited to announce the general availability of Amazon Data Firehose (Firehose) integration with Amazon S3 Tables, a feature that enables customers to deliver real-time streaming data into Amazon S3 Tables without requiring any code development or multi-step processes.

evidence.heading: Amazon Data Firehose now delivers real-time streaming data into Amazon S3 Tables
